parameter_evidence.all_numeric_controls: unmeasured_study; metres, source-frame azimuth, phase, five column angles, all support/platform heights and RGB are not historical measurements

roof_revisions_from_private_fixture.reason: complete source fit and five continuous columns wholly inside true lower hole

upper_visual_proportions.reason: private rise1.4/outer1.35 visually over-pointed versus official images; reduced rise is explicit visual study, not pixel measurement

parameter_evidence.source_support_reference: full seven-point neutral volume from 0 to study 2.4m; not fabricated mountain/rock silhouette or surveyed peak
parameter_evidence.reference_floor: one full seven-point study slab from2.4 to2.6m; not an interior/upper occupied-storey plate
parameter_evidence.continuous_columns: five axes at study phase+2pi*i/5, radius.8m; entire shaft lies in actual lower skin hole; upper tops clipped to real upper underside
parameter_evidence.lower_support: five .26m wide/.22m high radial beams overlap continuous columns and wholly cover .1m bearing feet; five caps clip real lower underside
parameter_evidence.rotation: roof phase baked into private mesh copies before T._contact_surface; source root transform applies once

unbuilt: Real mountain/rock geometry, measured peak/floor/bridge/column angles and complete source-to-current survey
